title: A turned-off person stays picked while Work Orders stays open
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, leading no work order.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B, with one approved line, line 1, holding a labor entry for staff member A, so staff member A has work that must not move and the board gives them no column once turned off.
  • Have Settings, Staff open in a second browser tab.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Technician filter.
  2. Pick staff member A in the Technician filter.
  3. Switch to the Settings, Staff tab.
  4. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  5. Switch Technician off.
  6. Click Save & Close.
  7. Click Save in the warning.
  8. Switch to the Board View tab.
  9. In the display switcher, pick "Tech View".
  10. Open the Technician filter.
  11. Untick staff member A in the Technician filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The filter offers staff member A.

Step 2:

  • The Technician filter is on, set to staff member A.

Step 3:

  • The staff list shows.

Step 4:

  • The window shows Technician on.

Step 5:

  • Technician is off.

Step 6:

  • The "Turn Off Technician" warning shows, because staff member A is on line 1.

Step 7:

  • The warning and the window close.
  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 8:

  • Board View shows, not reloaded.

Step 9:

  • Tech View shows.
  • Staff member A is the only person picked and has no group, so the board shows "No work orders match these filters".

Step 10:

  • Staff member A is still picked and offered in the filter.

Step 11:

  • The Technician filter is off.
  • Staff member B's group shows with work order 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 20 (3 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 4 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-N1: “A person with Technician off, or with Time Clock off, gets no Board View column, no Tech View group, and is not offered in the Technician filter or any technician dropdown, unless S3-E1 or S3-E2 applies. A person picked in the Technician filter whose Technician is turned off stays offered and picked while the board still gives them a column or group (S3-E1 or S3-E2). Once it no longer does, they stay picked while Work Orders stays open, until the user unticks them or changes location; if they are the only person picked, the board shows "No work orders match these filters". The next time Work Orders is opened from the menu, or the page is reloaded, they are no longer offered and drop out of the filter, as if never picked. A person picked at another location drops out when the location changes. Their work orders do not move.”
  • S3-R3: “The Technician filter on Work Orders offers the same people the board gives a column or group to.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
